resources.string: Your personal assistant on your phone.\nTell me what to do and I’ll get it done in the background.
Before you start: set up a model and turn on phone control. About 3 minutes.
Taps, types and scrolls on a background screen, leaving yours free
Built-in browser to read pages, compare prices and look things up
Spreadsheets, PDFs and data, computed and organized in a separate environment
Daily, weekly, or automatically when a condition is met
agentreins-moblie thinks with your own model service. Connect a provider first, then pick a model for each job.
Only the main model is required; the other two can wait.
Paste the key from your provider
agentreins-moblie lists this provider’s models, then asks one of them to call a test tool; if both work, it’s saved.
The base URL must start with http:// or https://
This address isn’t encrypted; your API key and chats could be seen by others on the network.

127.0.0.1 is this phone. If the server runs on your computer, replace it with the computer’s local network address and let the server accept connections from the network, not only from itself.
